description: Lists the connected account’s feeds, management links and shared active-feed allowance for a requested calendar lookup. Only feeds marked counts_towards_active_limit use a slot; this page’s length is not the account’s usage. Reading changes no feeds or subscription access. Scope is limited to the connected account’s Smart Calendars AI feeds. No mailbox access, source-document retrieval, automatic source monitoring, scheduled PDF checks or document refresh is provided. Structured schedule content is supplied explicitly by the caller. Result links: subscription_open_url is the exact HTTPS handoff to the default calendar app via webcal; subscription_options_url provides Apple/default, Google, Outlook and copy-link choices; subscription_url is the copyable HTTPS calendar-file fallback; manage_url opens the feed dashboard. URL hosts, paths and tokens identify the returned resource and are not interchangeable. A filtered_subscription has its own links for that selection; top-level links remain unfiltered. Subscription access requires distribution_ready=true. Opening a link does not confirm a subscription; confirmation occurs in the user’s calendar app.

limit.description: Maximum calendars returned on this page, from 1 to 100; defaults to 50.

offset.description: Number of matching results skipped before this page; defaults to 0. The response next_offset identifies the next page when present.

name: list_feeds
title: List calendars
